name: valid
role: 1 while the input is still acceptable; 0 once rejected

name: char
role: the byte just read; zero between reads

name: digit0
role: first year digit; moved into century then zero

name: digit1
role: second year digit; moved into century then zero

name: digit2
role: third year digit; moved into year then zero

name: digit3
role: fourth year digit; moved into year then zero

name: digit4
role: first month digit; moved into month then zero

name: digit5
role: second month digit; moved into month then zero

name: digit6
role: first day digit; moved into day then zero

name: digit7
role: second day digit; moved into day then zero

name: century
role: year div 100

name: year
role: year mod 100

name: month
role: month as entered

name: day
role: day as entered

name: century_mod4
role: century mod 4

name: century_leaps
role: ceil of century over 4

name: year_mod4
role: year mod 4

name: year_leaps
role: ceil of year over 4

name: leap
role: 1 if the full year is a Gregorian leap year

name: month_length
role: days in the entered month; 0 if no such month

name: month_offset
role: sum of earlier month lengths each taken mod 7

name: sum
role: weekday accumulator; zero after the final reduction

name: weekday
role: 0 is Monday through 6 Sunday; valid input only

name: out
role: output workspace; zero between characters
